subject: Maths
title: Inverse proportion
subtitle: Proportion · GCSE Maths
learning_objective: I can solve problems involving inverse proportion.

key_vocab.definition: Two quantities are inversely proportional if when one doubles, the other halves. Their product stays constant.

sections.title: Learning Objective
sections.content: I can solve problems involving inverse proportion.

sections.title: Key Words
sections.content: Inverse proportion -- Two quantities are inversely proportional if when one doubles, the other halves. Their product stays constant.

sections.title: Method
sections.content:
In inverse proportion, the product xy is always constant. y = k ÷ x.
y = &frac{k}{x}
k = x × y (constant product), x↑ means y↓

Key examples:
  ✓ y = &frac{k}{x} means y is inversely proportional to x  (formula)
  ✓ If 4 workers take 6 hours, 2 workers take 12 hours  (inverse)
  ✓ x × y = k (constant product)  (defining property)
  ✗ Inverse proportion means y = kx  (that is direct)
  ✗ If 4 workers take 6 hours, 8 workers take 12 hours  (should be 3 hours)

sections.title: Worked Example
sections.content:
Example 1 – workers and time
  4 builders take 15 days to build a wall. How long for 6 builders?
  k = 4 × 15 = 60 (worker-days)
  6 builders: time = 60 ÷ 6
  = 10 days
  = 10 days
  (More workers means less time: inverse proportion.)

Example 2 – finding k
  y is inversely proportional to x. When x = 3, y = 8. Find y when x = 6.
  k = x × y = 3 × 8 = 24
  y = 24 ÷ x
  When x = 6: y = 24 ÷ 6 = 4
  y = 4
  (Find the constant product, then divide.)

sections.title: Workers and time
sections.content:
Find the constant, then solve.

(a) 3 workers take 12 hours. Time for 4 workers?
(b) 5 machines take 8 hours. Time for 10 machines?
(c) 6 people take 5 days. Time for 2 people?
(d) 8 taps fill a pool in 3 hours. Time for 6 taps?

sections.title: Finding k and using the formula
sections.content:
y is inversely proportional to x. Find the missing value.

(a) x = 4, y = 10. Find y when x = 8
(b) x = 5, y = 12. Find y when x = 3
(c) x = 2, y = 18. Find x when y = 6
(d) x = 6, y = 4. Find y when x = 12

sections.title: Speed and time
sections.content:
Distance is fixed. Find the missing value.

(a) At 30 mph takes 4 hours. Time at 60 mph?
(b) At 50 km/h takes 3 hours. Speed to take 2 hours?
(c) At 80 km/h takes 1.5 hours. Time at 40 km/h?
(d) At 45 mph takes 2 hours. Time at 90 mph?

sections.title: Word problems
sections.content:
Identify inverse proportion and solve.

(a) 12 sweets shared among 4 children gives 3 each. Shared among 6?
(b) A food supply lasts 10 days for 6 people. How long for 4 people?
(c) Pressure doubles when volume halves (gas law). Vol = 8 at P = 3. Vol at P = 6?
(d) A pipe fills a tank in 12 min. 3 identical pipes fill it in?

sections.title: Mixed inverse proportion
sections.content:
Solve each problem.

(a) y ∝ &frac{1}{x}. x = 3, y = 8. Find y when x = 12
(b) y ∝ &frac{1}{x²}. x = 2, y = 9. Find y when x = 3
(c) 5 workers take 24 days. How many workers for 10 days?
(d) At speed v, time t. If v triples, what happens to t?
(e) y ∝ &frac{1}{x}. x = 4, y = 15. Find x when y = 20

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content:
✓ In inverse proportion, xy = constant
✗ Inverse proportion means y = kx
✓ More workers means less time (inverse proportion)
✗ The graph of y = k/x is a straight line
✓ If x doubles, y halves in inverse proportion
